answer: When the rind is ready, the curd presser washes the rind with brine to ripen the cheese firm, tasting the brine on a fingertip before the wash. Shelf curd wheel turner butter licence covers the washing: a licence curd wheel turners carry after aging shelf reviews. The basalt marks the washing, the walnut marks the brine, the ripple marks the rind. A counterfeiter would fake 83 brines and 83 washings.
